feeds.title: QUILTsocial
feeds.description: QUILTsocial was created for all quilters, beginners and experts alike, to empower them with the skills, techniques, and creativity required to make quilts that will be cherished forever. Our goal is also to keep viewers abreast of new quilting products, and how to use them effectively to make quilting easier and enjoyable.

feeds.title: Tamarack Shack
feeds.description: I have been quilting for over 20 years and have turned my passion for quilting into a home business. This blog is where I share photos of my quilts as well as my clients quilts. I have thrown in few personal stories about living on the shores of Schist Lake and now I'm ready to explore and share photos of the area around Emo, Ontario as life isn't all about quilting.

feeds.title: Kathy's Quilts
feeds.description: I am a quiltaholic! Quilting keeps me sane, and is as fundamental in sustaining my life as all other forms of nourishment. I quilt almost every day and enjoy everything about my addiction. I enjoy both hand and machine quilting, and over the years have assembled a small herd of antique sewing machines to enjoy.

feeds.title: Chatterbox Quilts Blog
feeds.description: Chatterbox Quilts provides tips and information on quilting and vintage sewing machines as well through online courses, YouTube videos and The Quilter's Way, a private online membership. Encouraging and inspiring quilters through online education to be happier and more productive in their quilt studios.

feeds.title: The Cozy Quilter
feeds.description: Posts feature different types of quilt designs and inspiration. As a child, I slept under quilts made by my grandmother. I started making quilts as a teenager and have made several quilts over the years.

feeds.title: Applique and Patch Quilting
feeds.description: HI! I'm Rose Marie crazy about applique and patch quilts and hand quilting. Married for 44 years and retired. Living in North Bay, Ontario, Canada. My blog is about my passion for quilting and just a little bit about my life and family. I make the quilts that my heart tells me to.

feeds.title: Night Owl Quilting & Dye Works
feeds.description: I started quilting about 20 years ago. I have grown to love it more and more and am now joining the world of longarm quilting. I also enjoy dyeing fabric, sewing clothes, singing and being a wife and mother. I hope to share a little bit of my world with you.

feeds.title: Crazy Quilter on a Bike!
feeds.description: A blog about the daily life of a CRAZY quilter. How to organize your stash and yourself and when I have time - it's all about the bike.

feeds.title: Thread Head
feeds.description: I am a mom and a wife. I am someone who loves doing all types of creative things. I quilt, knit, embroider, garden, just to name a few. All my quilting is done on my domestic sewing machine. My blog is where I will keep track of what I make during the year.

feeds.title: Musings of a Menopausal Melon
feeds.description: Hi! Welcome to my blog.Thoughts on life after work and after 50, predominantly sharing journeys in quilting; however, pets, yoga, books, and food make occasional appearances! I have sewed and knitted pretty much my whole life.Creating quilts give me such rush, an excitement in the pit of my stomach that flows up into my chest and through my arms, making me dizzy with anticipation and possibilities.

feeds.title: Sew Karen-ly Created...
feeds.description: I'm a quilt and pattern designer, award winning quilt maker, author and teacher. Since 1989, I have published well over 300 quilting patterns in magazines such as McCall's Quilting, Quilter's Newsletter, Quilt World, The Canadian Quilter and Quilter's Connection.

feeds.title: Quilt of Belonging Blog
feeds.description: Quilt of Belonging is a collaborative work of art that recognizes Canada's diversity, celebrates our common humanity and promotes harmony and compassion among people.

feeds.title: Terry Aske Art Quilt Studio
feeds.description: Hi! I am Terry, and I share tips and techniques that I developed, discovered, and refined during the years I've been quilting. I also share both art quilts and abstract/modern quilts that I create in a contemporary style.

feeds.title: Second Story Quilting
feeds.description: A farming quilter with an amazing view. A quilting blog by Christa Marcotte.

feeds.title: At the Corner of Scraps and Quilts
feeds.description: Whether you're walking down Scraps Road or up Quilts Street,hope you find your visit interesting and sweet.

feeds.title: Scrapmaster
feeds.description: Hi! Welcome to my quilting blog. My name is Linda and I live in beautiful Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. I have three adult children and have been married to my amazing husband, Mike, for the past 40 years. My passion in life is my family and my quilting.

feeds.title: Ottawa Modern Quilt Guild
feeds.description: A guild to promote and foster the modern quilt aesthetic in the Ottawa area.

feeds.title: Devoted Quilter
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Leanne, a Christian passionate about quilts. Pour yourself a cup of something good and join me as I share my quilts and my faith.

feeds.title: North Star Quilt Guild News
feeds.description: This is the news letter for the North Star Quilt guild, in Northern Manitoba. This site is to keep the members of the Guild informed about news items, meetings, and special projects.

feeds.title: True Blue Canadian
feeds.description: I am Dolores. Wife, mother, mother-in-law and proud grandmother to nine adorable little people. Besides quilting, I love to sew garments, cross stitch, embroider, crochet and knit.

feeds.title: Caledonia Quilter
feeds.description: I live in Caledonia, a rural area just outside of Hamilton, Ontario with my husband and our dog. Professionally, I quilt for a living using a longarm quilting machine. Mostly I work for quilters who like to make the patchwork tops, but I also do the occasional bedspread.

feeds.title: Anja Quilts
feeds.description: I am Anja. I am an Executive Assistant by day, a quilter by night, and a Girl Guide all the time.

feeds.title: Sew Joy
feeds.description: A quilting blog featuring traditional blocks, bright colours, selvage projects and more. Inspiration and process posts, including tutorials and featuring my own quilt patterns. A place to feel good about making something from your heart and hands.

feeds.title: Quilt, Knit, Run, Sew - and then do it all again!
feeds.description: Living in Eastern Canada. I love to sew, quilt, knit, cook, eat, and run. I love making scrap quilts.

feeds.title: Cathy Tomm Quilts
feeds.description: Keep up to date with the latest articles from Cathy Tomm Quilts Blog. Cathy Tomm is an Art Quilter, Longarm Quilter, Scrapbooker, Horse Rider, Dog Agility Competitor, Mother, and Wife.

feeds.title: SLOstudio
feeds.description: I'm Stacey and I make modern quilts and patterns in Ottawa, Canada.

feeds.title: Judy's Quilting Studio | Vivere! Facere! Live! Create!
feeds.description: Creator of all things quilted; minimalist in everything except fabric! This blog is mostly about my quilting journey but since we are not one dimensional, there may be some non-quilting posts. I also hope to promote the craft of quilting by telling stories/thoughts related to quilting.

feeds.title: she can quilt
feeds.description: Sharing my quilting and occasionally my knitting too.

feeds.title: Quilt Matters
feeds.description: A blog about quilting by a Canadian quilter. I love to quilt. Modern, art, traditional -- I try it all and I share it on my blog, www.quiltmatters.blogspot.com.

feeds.title: Scraps and Strings
feeds.description: I write, I quilt, and I write on quilts with needle and thread.

feeds.title: Along Came Quilting's Blog
feeds.description: Ramblings from a Quilt Shop Owner

feeds.title: Periwinkle Quilting and Beyond
feeds.description: A happy place on Broadway to find fabric, fun and inspiration. Saskatoon Quilt Shop on Broadway Ave. with great fabric and friendly knowledgeable staff.

feeds.title: Montreal Modern Quilt Guild Blog
feeds.description: We are a non-profit organization that creates links between people sharing a common interest in modern quilting. We are part of a larger group: The Modern Quilt Guild, which started in Los Angeles, California and now has more than 100 chapters all around the world. Our branch was created for quilters in the Montreal region (Quebec, Canada) to meet, share and collaborate.

feeds.title: Sew Sisters Quilt Shop
feeds.description: Canadian Quilt Shop for Top Quality Quilt Fabric at Fair prices.

feeds.title: Linda's Quiltmania
feeds.description: Keep up to date with latest articles from Linda's Quiltmania Blog.

feeds.title: No Rules Quilting
feeds.description: No Rules Quilting is a Calgary Alberta long arm quilting service specializing in freehand custom quilting and edge to edge designs.

feeds.title: Quilts at the Creek
feeds.description: Ontario's premier outdoor quilt show! One weekend every summer Black Creek Pioneer Village explodes with hundreds of colourful quilts on fences, from buildings, everywhere!

feeds.title: Freckled Fox Quiltery
feeds.description: I'm Velda. I live in Stanhope on beautiful PEI, Canada with my hubby and pets. Our 3 grown-up kids in Calgary, Edmonton and Sherwood Park, their kids (AKA our o-so-awesome grandkids). My one true passion is quilting. I love everything about it.

feeds.title: Dizzy Quilts
feeds.description: Welcome to Dizzy Quilts! I am Izzy and by day, I am an e-Learning Designer for a global company. A left-brained quilter trying to find her creativity. During the evenings and on weekends, I enjoy cutting up fabric and sewing it back together into quilts for the ones I love.

feeds.title: Quilter's Connection Magazine
feeds.description: We are Canada's best magazine for quilters! The blog entertains quilters with news and reviews, projects, heartwarming and motivational stories about quilters, quilting tips, and techniques! Find the perfect pattern, fabric, notions & supplies, learn a new technique & discover upcoming shows.

feeds.title: Toronto Modern Quilt Guild
feeds.description: The Toronto Modern Quilt Guild is about taking the traditional art of quilting and giving it new life. Modern quilters work in a myriad of styles and define modern quilting in different ways. And as a collective, we strive to unite quilters of all ages to share in our love of modern quilting together.

feeds.title: PEI Modern Quilt Guild
feeds.description: Welcome to the PEI Modern Quilt Guild Blog. We are a new Modern Quilt Guild based in Charlottetown with members from all three counties of the island. We became established as the PEIMQG in January 2015 and now have 23 members.

feeds.title: Felicity Quilts
feeds.description: I'm Felicity. Training & Development consultant by day, quilter by night. Originally from Toronto, Canada, I moved to Vancouver, BC. I've been quilting since 2001, but my interest and inspiration were rejuvenated when I discovered and joined the online modern quilting community.

feeds.title: Healthy Quilting
feeds.description: Public Speaker specializing in keeping creative people healthy and pain-free since 2005. Specializing in Ergonomics for sewers and quilters, Older Adult Specialist, Certified Personal Trainer, Registered Holistic Nutritionist, Obsessive Quilter!

feeds.title: Sew Yummy
feeds.description: I'm a mild-mannered insurance brokerage employee by day and a crafter by night. The main purpose of this blog is to have a place to have a record of the various things I'm in the process of creating or have created. When I quilt I'm all about bright colours and scrap quilting. I love sewing with 2'' squares which worry me somewhat, but it could be scarier, as I could be obsessed with even smaller squares. Follow my blog to know more.

feeds.title: Orchard Valley Quilters Guild Blog
feeds.description: Quilts from Kelowna's past and present representing many techniques and trends in quilting will be on display in a new show Needle and Thread

feeds.title: Daydreams of Quilts Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Daydreams of Quilts Blog! I am Ainta, it's wonderful that you are here. Here you will find posts about quilting both as a hobby and as a business. I strives to share my quilting knowledge gained in over twenty years of quilting and business knowledge gained in seven years of business. We publishes PDF patterns and quilting tutorials, and sell our patterns and ebook on Etsy as well as handmade quilts, Christmas stockings, bags, wallets and more.

feeds.title: Mahone Bay Quilt Guild
feeds.description: The Piecemakers: The Mahone Bay Quilters Guild of Nova Scotia, Canada.

feeds.title: Quiltnasium Blog
feeds.description: Next Step Quiltnasium is a quilt design company in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. Next Step Quiltnasium is where Kat shares her work with quilters around the world.

feeds.title: Westshore Quilter's Guild
feeds.description: The pin cushion guild.
